deterministic.description: Single-process mechanics with fake upstreams and injected clocks; no credentials

multi_process_private.description: Separate scheduler/control-plane/worker processes on private infrastructure; owner approval required

scenarios.title: Fairness across three weighted projects
pass_criteria: each project's admitted share within relative_share_error of weight/sum(weights)
every eligible project admitted at least once

scenarios.title: Anti-amplification under 50+ task expansion
pass_criteria: expanding project share within tolerance of its weight share (0.5)

scenarios.title: Two-project isolation negatives
pass_criteria: cross-project ops-event read denied (403)
cross-tenant worker placement rejected and audited
pack enabled for project A is not usable by project B
mismatched task/mission project is never admitted (isolation_denied)

scenarios.title: Restart preserves pending work, credits, intents and fencing
pass_criteria: state reloaded from the durable store equals state before restart
positive credit clamped by restart cap; debt preserved
expired PREPARED/RESERVED intents compensated exactly once
stale scheduler epoch cannot write

scenarios.title: Drain with active leases
pass_criteria: draining worker receives no new placement
draining mission receives no new admission
no duplicate accepted result

scenarios.title: Capability pack lifecycle
pass_criteria: install -> enable for one project -> deny other project -> drain -> disable -> uninstall
unsigned or wrongly-signed pack refused when signatures required
no implicit capability widening

scenarios.title: Portability export/import into a clean root
pass_criteria: no secret values in the bundle (key and value scan)
section digests verify after import
imported approvals/leases are tombstoned and cannot execute

scenarios.title: End-to-end trace chain
pass_criteria: trace graph links operator.action -> mission.created -> scheduler.decision -> attempt.started -> inference.call|tool.effect -> artifact.stored -> acceptance.recorded
trace is complete (no missing links) using durable ids

scenarios.title: Failure truth: provider unavailable and worker loss
pass_criteria: decision is DEFER with deferred_resource_unavailable, never ADMIT
ops events record the blocked state; no mock success

scenarios.title: Zero-spend operator profile
pass_criteria: route with billing paid or unknown is denied with paid_route_forbidden
no fallback to a paid route

scenarios.title: Multi-process / private live evidence
pass_criteria: ART protocol items 1, 4, 5, 9 repeated with separate processes on private infrastructure
